# tests/fixtures/v4/mirror/ — stamp helper

`_stamp.mjs` (CONTRACT §4.3) — hand-stamps a mirror-fixture twin: prints the
`<meta name="planit-*">` lines to paste into a twin's `<head>`. Used while
building the `mirror-*` fixtures under `tests/fixtures/v4/`; not itself a
fixture and not a `T-V4B` case ID.
